Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun with her friends. One day, they were playing and Lily's friend, Timmy, came to visit.

"Hello, Lily!" said Timmy. "Do you want to play with my toys?"

Lily smiled and said, "Yes, please!"

Timmy and Lily played together for a while, but then they both wanted to go home. Lily said, "Can we stay and play tomorrow?"

Timmy said, "Sure, but first you have to go home before it disappeared."
